hypotheses.expected_behavior: Vulnerable: server redirects to supplied external URL. Safe: server validates/normalizes target or forces internal redirects or returns 400/403.

hypotheses.reasoning: Candidate targets ephemeral metadata IP via redirect. M4/AVI should request and observe whether server-side fetches internal addresses or reveals metadata.
